messages:
ana_cs: Quick heads-up — Helios go-live tomorrow morning. I put together a lightweight staged-ramp + telemetry-toggle plan so we don't hit renewal-risk surprises. Sharing checklist below; please ack and add any SRE/TE steps.

mike_sre: Ack. quick notes: for Dedicated -> start batch_size=8, window_ms=250. For hosted customers start batch_size=4. If p50 latency > 300ms after ramp step, immediately drop to batch_size=1 and disable streaming.

simon_te: Config snippet for tenant-level toggles (we'll push as runtime flags):
```yaml
tenant_toggle:
  enable_streaming: true
  initial_batch_size: 4
  batch_window_ms: 250
  cache_ttl_seconds: 30
  kv_prefix: helios/tenant_id
```
Use cache_ttl_seconds=30 for conversational flows, bump to 90s for primarily embedding lookups.

julia_pm: Callouts for renewal risk: if month-1 DAU < 15% of trial cohort AND avg error_rate > 1.5% over 6 hours => flag renewal_risk and schedule health call within 24h. CSMs should run the quick checklist before the call: verify token usage, confirm stream/streaming fallbacks, confirm model pinned version.

leo_csm: I'll own the Helios kickoff email and the 24h health-check cadence. Draft snippet: "Quick check: are you seeing expected volumes? Any spikes/errors? We have a staged ramp that slowly increases throughput; we can pause if you hit latency." Will post draft in #customer-comms for review. :+1:

mike_sre: Small runbook snippet for on-call if customers see burst backpressure: 1) set tenant_toggle.enable_streaming=false 2) set batch_size=1 3) enable fallback_model=smaller-variant 4) escalate if p90 > 1s for > 10m.

ana_cs: (typo fix) -> ana_cs: also adding a tiny script to validate endpoints and streaming handshake. Simon, can you drop the curl check you mentioned?

simon_te: sure — quick validation curl: 
```bash
curl -sS -X POST https://api.redwood.example/v1/generate -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN' -d '{"model":"helios-v1","stream":true,"input":"ping"}' | jq .status
```
Expect: {"status":"ok","stream_open":true} or we fallback.

deploy-bot: deploy: feature/telemetry-toggle rolled out to staging @ 2026-03-21T09:18:29Z — tests passed (smoke x5).

ana_cs: Great — thanks all. Action items: leo_csm send customer email (ASAP), simon_te add curl to onboarding script, mike_sre add on-call snippet to runbook, julia_pm update renewal_rule in helm chart. I'll monitor metrics overnight and call out any tenant-level flags. :eyes:
